name: io.github.cloudformer/idlefree-mcp
description: MCP tools for the IdleFree family: check PyPI names and register one as an empty placeholder.

environmentVariables.description: Your GitHub user/org — a registered name's page links github.com/<owner>/<name>; also tells 'already registered by you' from 'taken'
environmentVariables.name: IDLEFREE_OWNER

environmentVariables.description: Author on the placeholder (defaults to the owner)
environmentVariables.name: IDLEFREE_AUTHOR

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a reserved.yaml ledger of registers and refusals
environmentVariables.name: IDLEFREE_RESERVED_LOG

environmentVariables.description: PyPI upload token (falls back to the [pypi] password in ~/.pypirc)
environmentVariables.name: PYPI_TOKEN
